totals.description: Look-through breakdowns (by_region/by_currency/by_duration/by_liquidity_tier) follow economic_exposure precedence: holding.economic_exposure > asset_type.economic_exposure. Holdings without exposure data fall into the '__unclassified__' bucket so coverage gaps remain visible. As a pragmatic fallback, by_currency uses holdings[].market_value.currency when no exposure is declared.

by_account.description: Base-currency value per policy account_id; '__unassigned__' bucket holds holdings without an account_id.

by_strategic_bucket.description: Base-currency value per policy strategic_allocation target, keyed '<dimension>:<bucket>' (e.g. 'asset_class:stocks'). '__unallocated__' holds value not covered by any policy target.
